about_short_description.short_description: Givefront is the financial operating system for non-profits.

product.name: Nonprofit Accounting
product.description: Provides bookkeeping, accounting, and tax services for nonprofits, including monthly financial reports, tax filing, and real-time financial insights.

product.name: Nonprofit Banking Platform
product.description: Offers a comprehensive financial management system for nonprofits, including dedicated bookkeeping and accounting services.

product.name: Start a 501(c) Nonprofit
product.description: Assists in preparing and filing state and IRS applications to establish a nonprofit organization and obtain 501(c)(3) status.

product.name: Nonprofit Resource Center
product.description: Provides educational resources and guides on various topics such as grant writing, financial audits, and donor relationship management.
